evolua.title: Evolua · Sistema Ailos
evolua.excerpt: Manual process automation with RPA and Playwright, workflow development and AI agent initiatives at the cooperative. One process went from around 1 hour to 2 minutes.
evolua.body:
## Current work

At **Cooperativa Evolua, part of Sistema Ailos**, I work on automating manual processes and contribute to AI agent initiatives.

## Approach

- Map operational routines and identify repetitive steps.
- Use **RPA and Playwright** to automate interactions previously performed manually.
- Build workflows that reduce time spent on operations.
- Contribute to **AI agent** initiatives.

## A practical result

One process that took approximately **1 hour** now takes **2 minutes** with automation. This example describes the time saved in a specific routine, freeing the team for other activities.

espacochurch-jobs.title: Espaço Church Jobs
espacochurch-jobs.excerpt: A professional directory connecting talent, services and opportunities in the community. Profiles, category search, authentication and contact through WhatsApp or LinkedIn.
espacochurch-jobs.body:
## Context

An independent platform connecting **professionals, services and opportunities** within the Espaço Church Pelotas community. This is a separate project from the church’s institutional website and management system.

## Features

- A directory with search and professional category filters.
- Profiles with biographies, skills and contact links.
- Member registration and authentication with **Supabase**.
- Direct contact through WhatsApp or LinkedIn.

## Development

**Next.js, React and TypeScript** on the frontend, **Supabase** for the database and authentication, and **CSS Modules** for styling.

[View documentation and code on GitHub](https://github.com/pepemesquita/espacochurch-jobs).

farrapos-field.title: Farrapos Field
farrapos-field.excerpt: Monthly payment management for a flag football field: fundraising progress, members, payment status and a Pix key in a mobile-first interface.
farrapos-field.body:
## Context

A system for organizing **monthly payments for a flag football field**, bringing contributions and members together in a mobile-first interface.

## Features

- A fundraising dashboard showing progress towards a monthly target.
- Month navigation and payment charge generation.
- Member listings and paid/pending payment tracking.
- A Pix key with a copy button.
- Member registration and deactivation.

## Development

**Next.js, React and TypeScript**, with **SCSS Modules** for styling and **Supabase/PostgreSQL** for data.

[View documentation and code on GitHub](https://github.com/pepemesquita/farrapos-field).

unireserva.title: UniReserva
unireserva.excerpt: An academic room and laboratory booking system, developed with a team at UFPel. Next.js frontend and a Python server with TLS communication.
unireserva.body:
## Context

An academic project for the **Computer Networks course at UFPel**, developed with teammates **Rafael and Mauro**.

## Features

View available rooms and laboratories, book time slots and browse reservations by date.

## Development

- **Next.js, React and TypeScript** on the frontend.
- A **Python server with TLS** for the booking API.
- Reservation persistence in a **JSON** file.

The project applies client-server communication, networking and web integration concepts.

[View documentation and code on GitHub](https://github.com/pepemesquita/Unireserva).

nexedia.title: Nexedia
nexedia.excerpt: Computer vision and AI for dentistry. An integrated web platform, report workflows through WhatsApp, an n8n agent and a platform redesign.
nexedia.body:
## Context

Nexedia is a computer vision and AI product for dentistry. The challenge was to combine the **web experience**, **report automation** requested through WhatsApp and **intelligent agents** into a reliable workflow for clinics and patients.

## How it was built

1. **React frontend** — a web interface integrated with the website, ongoing UX improvements and a Figma redesign for clear reports and follow-up screens.
2. **Report automation through WhatsApp** — workflows to receive requests, normalize data and route it through processing and delivery, reducing manual work.
3. **n8n agent** — reusable workflows for integrations, validations and notifications, with Python and additional APIs where custom logic was needed.
4. **Computer vision** — integration with the product’s dental image analysis capabilities.

## Challenges

Balancing response time, report quality and data governance required iteration with the team and adjustments to n8n workflows and the API.

## Outcome

A connected website, automation system and agent aligned with clinic operations, with room for additional examination types and integrations.

teeth-detection.title: Teeth Detection & Segmentation
teeth-detection.excerpt: YOLOv8 research for detecting and segmenting deciduous and permanent teeth in children aged 4–12, with a dataset developed alongside UFRGS dentistry.
teeth-detection.body:
## Context

An academic **tooth detection and segmentation** project covering deciduous and permanent teeth in children aged 4–12, with a dataset developed alongside **UFRGS Dentistry**.

## How it was built

- **Ultralytics YOLOv8** for training and inference, with annotations and a data pipeline adapted to dental images.
- **Python** for preprocessing, training, metric evaluation and result export.
- An iterative cycle of data preparation, training, validation and parameter and augmentation adjustments for the graduation project.

## Challenges

Image variability, class imbalance and coordination with specialists to maintain consistent labels.

## Outcome

Applied healthcare computer vision experience, with code and experiments documented in a public repository.

quires.title: Quires
quires.excerpt: AI agents for real estate: lead qualification, database queries and CRM integration. Internal and client automations, plus React Native mobile development.
quires.body:
## Context

Quires works on **automation and AI** for real estate. My full stack work covered **agents**, internal and client **n8n workflows**, and a **mobile application**.

## How it was built

1. **AI agents** — lead qualification, database queries and CRM integrations reflecting business rules.
2. **n8n** — internal and customer-facing automations with webhooks, APIs, schedules and observable error handling.
3. **React Native and Expo** — app screens, navigation, builds and rapid iteration with the team.
4. **Python** — supporting scripts and services for logic beyond practical visual workflows.

## Challenges

Orchestrating multiple integrations while maintaining idempotency, logs and retries without overloading support.

## Outcome

More predictable sales and operational workflows, with a mobile app connected to the same data sources.

primeira-mesa.title: Primeira Mesa
primeira-mesa.excerpt: Automation and intelligent workflows for a restaurant app. Process mapping and integrations supporting reservations, payments and customer service.
primeira-mesa.body:
## Context

Primeira Mesa is a restaurant app. My experience includes **automation**, **support** and resolving recurring issues with reservations, payments and app usage.

## How it was built

- Map failures and operational bottlenecks with the team.
- Use **n8n workflows** to integrate systems, notify responsible teams and reduce manual steps.
- Work with **React** in the existing web ecosystem and **Python/PHP** for legacy integrations.
- Monitor and refine workflows to reduce support costs and repeated work.

## Challenges

Integrating heterogeneous systems and keeping failures traceable in production.

## Outcome

A more stable operation and fewer repetitive support tickets for the internal team.

enderson-imports.title: Enderson Imports
enderson-imports.excerpt: Two AI agents for lead qualification, plus a personal and business finance dashboard. n8n, Python, Supabase, Meta API, Chatwoot and Slack integrations.
enderson-imports.body:
## Context

Two main areas for **Enderson Imports**: **lead acquisition and qualification** for iPhones and monthly plans, and a **personal and business finance dashboard** consolidating transactions across the client’s companies.

## Sales agents

Two agents have distinct roles: one handles **iPhone sales** and the other **monthly plans**. Both qualify and route conversations to the human team.

**Stack and integrations:**

- **n8n** — workflow orchestration, webhooks and branching based on lead intent.
- **Python** — business rules, data normalization and custom logic.
- **Supabase** — persistence for leads, conversation history and state.
- **Meta API** — official messaging channel.
- **Chatwoot** — a shared inbox with queues, labels and pipeline visibility.
- **Slack** — real-time sales team alerts.
- **Real-time notifications** — triggers to surface opportunities outside peak hours.

The design prioritizes traceability and clear handoff to a human.

## Finance dashboard and assistant

A dashboard brings together personal and business finances. A conversational agent acts as an assistant: the user describes expenses and income; the agent classifies and records transactions and keeps the dashboard updated, reducing parallel spreadsheets and missed entries.

## Challenges

Keeping sales and finance permissions separate, minimizing sensitive data in messages and maintaining consistency between the agent’s interpretation and saved records through confirmations and logs.

## Outcome

More predictable commercial operations on WhatsApp and Instagram, and centralized financial visibility.

espaco-church.title: Espaço Church Pelotas
espaco-church.excerpt: An institutional website and an internal platform for members, courses, events, attendance and administration, with Wi-Fi integration and optional facial recognition.
espaco-church.body:
A **full stack** platform combining the **public website** of Espaço Church Pelotas with an **internal system** for members, leaders and administrative staff. I developed the project end to end.

## What the project covers

### Visitors and the community

Institutional pages covering history, mission, location and ministries; an event calendar, fellowship groups, first-visit and faith content, Pix contributions, volunteering, a contact form and search visibility.

### Members

Registration approved by the church office, secure login and access levels based on each person’s role. A **course area** with videos, materials, progress tracking and **achievements** that encourage participation.

### Events and attendance

Management of events, including recurring events, member attendance and visitor registration, a real-time participation view and a unified calendar.

### Church Wi-Fi

People joining the network can identify themselves through a simple flow that can **automatically record attendance** during services and events, with a visitor flow available at those times.

### Facial recognition (optional in the workflow)

Members can update their photos with explicit consent under Brazil’s LGPD. **AI** supports arrival identification through cameras and attendance and security workflows, with human review when someone is not identified.

### Leadership and ministries

Tools for groups and ministries: meetings, attendance, members, visitors, schedules and reports, including specific workflows for the **Kids Ministry**.

### Administration

An overview dashboard; management of people, courses, events and contact messages; batch data import; attendance and participation reports; and basic operational security controls.

---

A **private** project for Espaço Church Pelotas.

bc-energia.title: BC Energia
bc-energia.excerpt: Automated collection and structuring of customer data to support marketing and advertising strategies, using Python, n8n and APIs.
bc-energia.body:
## Context

BC Energia needed to **structure customer and account data** for marketing strategies and advertising campaigns.

## How it was built

- **Python** for scraping, error handling and data normalization.
- **n8n** to orchestrate steps, schedules and delivery to spreadsheets or internal APIs.
- Third-party **API integrations** aligned with business rules.

## Challenges

Handling layout changes on source websites and rate limits while keeping daily workflows running.

## Outcome

More reliable data for the growth team, with less manual collection work.

orsai.title: OrsAI
orsai.excerpt: Full stack development with React.js, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Serverless and AWS Lambda.
orsai.body:
## Context

A **full stack application** for an OrsAI digital product, combining a rich frontend experience and resilient backend APIs.

## How it was built

- **React.js and Next.js** for routes, rendering and frontend performance.
- **Node.js** REST endpoints and **PostgreSQL** integration.
- **AWS Lambda and Serverless** for asynchronous tasks, webhooks and usage-based infrastructure.

## Challenges

Managing cold starts, timeouts and observability across distributed services.

## Outcome

A scalable technical foundation for ongoing product development.

euvatar.title: Euvatar
euvatar.excerpt: Full stack internship focused on automation, proprietary AI integrations and immersive interfaces.
euvatar.body:
## Context

My **full stack development internship** at Euvatar focused on automation, proprietary AI integrations and immersive interfaces.

## How it was built

- **React and Next.js** for web workflows and reusable components.
- **n8n** to connect integrations and reduce manual work between systems.
- **Python** for supporting services and extensions.

## Challenges

Maintaining UX quality while backend services and automations grew in parallel.

## Outcome

Ongoing feature delivery with less friction between design and implementation.

dogs-nose-detection.title: Dogs Nose Detection
dogs-nose-detection.excerpt: A YOLOv8 model for detecting dog noses in images, developed as a foundation for future scientific research.
dogs-nose-detection.body:
## Context

Applied research on **dog nose detection with YOLOv8**, providing a basis for future scientific studies.

## How it was built

- Dataset assembly and annotations focused on the nose region.
- Training with **Ultralytics YOLOv8** and metric evaluation, including mAP and recall.
- **Python** for training and batch inference.

## Challenges

Occlusion, varying lighting and noisy backgrounds.

## Outcome

A reproducible pipeline and a foundation for future tracking or animal behavior research.

farmine-land.title: Farmine Land
farmine-land.excerpt: Game backend work with C++, Lua and XML, Web3 integration and contributions to gameplay design.
farmine-land.body:
## Context

Backend work on the online game **Farmine Land**, including **Web3** integration.

## How it was built

- **C++ and Lua** for server logic, events and balancing.
- **XML** in the project’s content and configuration pipelines.
- Contributions to gameplay design in collaboration with the team.

## Challenges

Balancing server performance, the in-game economy and blockchain integrations.

## Outcome

More predictable game services and support for the game’s continued evolution.

forma-palavras.title: Forma Palavras
forma-palavras.excerpt: An educational word-building game using images, built with React Native, TypeScript and Expo. Activity records and reports support specialist observation.
forma-palavras.body:
## Context

A digital implementation of the physical **Forma Palavras** game, where children form words from images. The project has an educational purpose and supports specialist observation through activity records and reports.

## How it was built

- **React Native and TypeScript** for interfaces and components.
- **Expo** for mobile and web execution.
- Audio, navigation and report export features included in the project.
- **Figma** for screen design and prototyping.

## Goal

Support educational activities and observation by professionals, including work with children with autism. The app does not replace clinical assessment.

[View code and instructions on GitHub](https://github.com/pepemesquita/Forma_Palavras).

dubinhas.title: Dubinhas
dubinhas.excerpt: A React Native and TypeScript app that helps teachers and students with hearing disabilities communicate and collaborate at school.
dubinhas.body:
## Context

An app helping **teachers and students with hearing disabilities** communicate and organize school activities.

## How it was built

- **React Native and TypeScript** for UI components and workflows.
- **Expo** for builds and quick iteration in school settings.
- **Node.js** where synchronization and content services were needed.

## Challenges

Prioritizing accessibility through contrast, visual feedback and gestures alongside text.

## Outcome

A mobile project addressing a concrete need in inclusive education.

face-recognition.title: Face Recognition
face-recognition.excerpt: Real-time face recognition in Python for university robotics, using OpenCV, Dlib, Haar Cascade and MediaPipe.
face-recognition.body:
## Context

A **Python** implementation for the university robotics group, using camera input and near-real-time **face recognition**.

## How it was built

- **OpenCV** for frame capture and preprocessing.
- **Dlib**, **Haar Cascade** and **MediaPipe** for experiments with different performance requirements.
- A modular pipeline allowing detectors to be changed without rewriting the application.

## Challenges

Variable lighting in competition environments and acceptable latency for robot control.

## Outcome

A working demonstration within the university’s **SSL robotics** ecosystem.

hospital-system.title: Hospital Management System
hospital-system.excerpt: An academic hospital management system for doctors, pharmacy, patients and administration. Node.js, Express and MySQL.
hospital-system.body:
## Context

A **hospital management system** with modules for doctors, pharmacy, patients and administration.

## How it was built

- **JavaScript** on the frontend and **Node.js/Express** on the backend.
- **MySQL** with a normalized relational model and profile-based permissions.
- **Apache** in the academic deployment environment.

## Challenges

Modeling clinical workflows with referential integrity and minimal data redundancy.

## Outcome

An academic project demonstrating CRUD operations, authentication and separation of responsibilities.

ai-classification.title: AI Classification
ai-classification.excerpt: Decision-tree classification with public datasets for the UFPel Artificial Intelligence Hub, using Python and Scikit-learn.
ai-classification.body:
## Context

A project for the **UFPel Artificial Intelligence Hub**, comparing classification approaches in **Python** using public datasets.

## How it was built

- **Scikit-learn**, decision trees and validation metrics.
- Data preprocessing and basic feature engineering for each dataset.
- Reproducible notebooks and scripts for group presentations.

## Challenges

Avoiding overfitting on small datasets and communicating results accurately.

## Outcome

An educational foundation that other students can use to reproduce and compare algorithms.

cache-simulator.title: Cache Simulator
cache-simulator.excerpt: An educational cache simulator with a random replacement policy for exploring memory management.
cache-simulator.body:
## Context

An educational **cache memory simulator** with a **random replacement policy**, developed for a computer architecture course.

## How it was built

- **Python** to model sets, cache lines, hits and misses.
- A simple interface for memory access traces.
- Aggregated metrics to compare scenarios.

## Challenges

Ensuring that the model matches expected behavior from the course material.

## Outcome

A teaching tool for exploring the impact of cache replacement policies.

apollum.title: Apollum
apollum.excerpt: A UFPel Startup Weekend concept for a personalized music player, including UX/UI research and a Figma prototype.
apollum.body:
## Context

A **UFPel Startup Weekend** project to create a product concept within a few days, including research, a pitch and a prototype.

## How it was built

- Rapid discovery through interviews and desk research.
- **Apollum**, a concept for a highly customizable music player.
- **Figma** for an interactive prototype and end-to-end UX/UI work.

## Challenges

A short deadline and the need for a clear product story for the judges.

## Outcome

Product development experience extending beyond code, from the initial problem to a visual solution.

resgate-princesa.title: Rescue the Princess!
resgate-princesa.excerpt: A 2D RPG in Java, developed as the final undergraduate Object-Oriented Programming project.
resgate-princesa.body:
## Context

A **2D RPG** built as the final **Object-Oriented Programming** course project, applying inheritance, polymorphism and basic patterns.

## How it was built

- **Java** for 2D maps, sprites and collisions.
- Player, enemy and item entities modeled as collaborating classes.

## Challenges

Keeping the code organized as the game’s scope grew near the deadline.

## Outcome

A playable academic project and a public source repository.

blackjack.title: Blackjack
blackjack.excerpt: A Blackjack game in C, developed as the final Computer Programming course project.
blackjack.body:
## Context

A **Blackjack game in C**, developed as the final Computer Programming course project, focusing on structs, pointers and modular code.

## How it was built

- Models for the deck, hands and rules such as hit, stand and bust.
- A terminal game loop with input validation.

## Challenges

Avoiding memory leaks while keeping the code readable without object-oriented programming.

## Outcome

Practical experience applying C fundamentals to a familiar game.
